description: OlympiadMAS auxiliary corpora (辅集) — question-level skill probes / secondary splits. Not counted toward primary session catalog (index.json / index2.json).
note: Prefer session tracks in index.json / index2.json for multi-agent olympiad eval. These datasets are single-question (or CTF/puzzle) rows; sample or packet-aggregate. Policy: benchmark_extracted/UNIT_POLICY.md.
